sentences.text: On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm that the 2% pre-payment charge complies, because the current RBI direction says a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges on loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, but the applicability finding is still unknown without the sanction date.
The bank's policy says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.

The RBI directions in force also say that the applicability of the pre-payment-charge rules depends on loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, so the sanction date is needed to confirm whether the rule governs this letter.

missing.searched: Checked the supplied evidence and rule findings for the sanction date of the MSE sanction letter; it was not provided.
